meta.title: Evelym Marinho · Backend Software Engineer
meta.description: Portfolio of Evelym Marinho, a backend software engineer with over 6 years of experience in Python, FastAPI, Django, and microservices, and author of research papers published in IEEE and ACM.

hero.name: Evelym Marinho
hero.tagline: Backend software engineer. For more than 6 years I've built scalable, highly available RESTful APIs in Python, from the first test to the deploy on Kubernetes, and I publish research on test automation and CI/CD.
hero.scene_alt: 3D illustration: me, wearing a purple sweatshirt and headphones, coding on a laptop. Around me, three panels show the Python code for an API being written, the automated tests passing, and the "deploy to production" badge.

about.label: About
about.title: Backend software engineer, researcher, and Python developer for over 6 years.
about.lead: I have a degree in Information Systems from UFAM, and I build backend systems in the Python ecosystem: RESTful APIs with FastAPI and Django, microservices with Docker and Kubernetes, integrating PostgreSQL and NoSQL databases.
about.bio_1: Today, I’m a backend software engineer at Sidia, where I lead the development of high-performance REST APIs for global products. Previously, at Bemol Digital, I designed ETL processes and optimized SQL queries in high-availability systems for the retail industry.
about.bio_2: I apply the same rigor to my research: I am the lead author of papers on test automation and CI/CD published in IEEE SEAI 2024 and ICSCA 2026.
about.skills_extra: technical leadership in API development, secure integration between APIs and interfaces, SQL query optimization, ETL processes for large volumes of data, and agile cycles.

e2e-ciflow.title: E2E-CIFlow
e2e-ciflow.description: An automated End-to-End testing process inside the CI/CD pipeline. With it, the team ships faster, deploys more often, and catches failures earlier.
e2e-ciflow.did: I proposed the process and integrated it into the pipeline using Playwright and GitHub Actions. I presented the work at ICSCA 2026 in Langkawi, and the paper was published in the ACM Digital Library.

sidia.organization: Sidia Institute of Science and Technology
sidia.description: I develop backend solutions in Python and Java for global products. I lead the development of high-performance REST APIs in microservice architectures, using Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines, and I apply TDD, Pytest, and code reviews to ensure quality, scalability, and security.

bemol.description: I developed high-availability systems for the retail sector that handle large volumes of data. I designed ETL processes, optimized SQL queries in PostgreSQL and NoSQL (Redis), and ensured secure integration between APIs and interfaces using agile development cycles.

bachelor.description: Undergraduate thesis approved with the highest grade (10).
